name: CUCKOO Homesys Co., Ltd
summary: CUCKOO Homesys Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, and rental of home appliances in South Korea and internationally. The company offers rice cookers; induction range, dishwasher, food processor, blenders, refrigerator, and freezer; microwave oven, air fryer, toaster, electric kettle, Filter-type water purifier, Other kitchen appliances; and vacuum cleaner.
